overview_description.description: Saga AI provides AI-powered communication agents for healthcare organizations, including practices, accountable care organizations, and health systems. The platform deploys voice agents to handle inbound and outbound calls for appointment scheduling, rescheduling, follow-ups, and prior authorization status checks. It also supports SMS and email for proactive patient outreach, care gap closure, reminders, and billing-related notifications. Saga AI integrates in real time with electronic health record systems and scheduling tools to read and write visit details, intake data, and authorizations. Administrators use a dashboard and review inbox to oversee patient conversations, approve sensitive messages, and manage workflows. The service is designed for use by healthcare operations and clinical support staff rather than as a clinical decision-making tool.
